title.narrative: Central Asia Regional Economic Cooperation Corridors 1 and 3 Connector Road Project

description.narrative: The project will connect two major CAREC regional corridors by rehabilitating a crucial connector road, part of the North-South Alternate Corridor, which is a priority in the National Sustainable Development Strategy. It will improve connectivity and mobility in the country and link the economic underprivileged regions with the economic hubs, as well as strengthen road maintenance practices and institutional capacity by introducing and implementing a road asset management system and a project implementation unit administrative manual and procedure.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Efficiency and safer movement of people and goods improved

Daily vehicle traffic from Epkin to Bashkugandy (annual average) increased to 5,572 by 2028 (2015 baseline: 1,621) Achievement: 1621 Progress/Status: To be assessed after project completion.
The first civil works contract (with Todini) was signed on 7 September 2018 and was terminated on 1 December 2020.
Following rebidding, the civil works contract (with CR5) was signed on 23 September 2021. Notification on commencement of works was issued to CR5 on 14 January 2022.
The construction works on the Bashkugandy-Epkin road section was substantially completed on 30 Nov 2024, the road was opened for public use. On the same date, the contractor commenced defect notification period. Data Source: MOTR progress reports

Daily vehicle traffic from Balykchy to Epkin (annual average) increased to 9,112 by 2028 (2017 baseline: 2,061) Achievement: 2061 Progress/Status: To be assessed after project completion.
The civil works contract (with Sinohydro) was signed on 14 February 2020. Notification on commencement of works was issued to Sinohydro on 22 June 2020. Data Source: MOTR progress reports

Travel time between Naryn and Osh reduced by 50% by 2028 (2015 baseline: 22 hours) Achievement: 22 Progress/Status: To be assessed after project completion.
The first civil works contract (with Todini) was signed on 7 September 2018 and was terminated on 1 December 2020.
Following rebidding, the civil works contract (with CR5) was signed on 23 September 2021. Notification on commencement of works was issued to CR5 on 14 January 2022.
The construction works on the Bashkugandy-Epkin road section was substantially completed on 30 Nov 2024, the road was opened for public use. On the same date, the contractor commenced defect notification period. Data Source: MOTR progress reports
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: 1.2 Four access roads with a total length of 11 km rehabilitated Indicator: Ak-Chyi village road (entrance section, 0.5 km), Zhany-Aryk village road (entrance section, 3 km), Kuiruchuk-Shilvili road (1.5 km), and the Zhumgal-Lama road (6 km) rehabilitated and paved (2025 baseline: four Category IV roads are in poor condition and unpaved). Data Source: Progress Reports Actual value:

Output: 3.2 Eight access roads with a total length of 39.5 km rehabilitated Indicator: Tendik-Roundabout road (2.9 km), Kum-Dobo-Komsomol road (17.16 km), Kum- Dobo-Shamshy-Saralasaz road (3.86 km), Communism-Ortok road (0.8 km), Cholpon- Kochkor-Epkin road (0.41 km), Kyzyl-Ompol-Ak-Olon road (12.28 km), Balykchy road (access to the base of Ministry of Emergency, 1.66 km), and Balykchy road (entrance section, 0.44 km) rehabilitated and paved (2025 baseline: eight roads are in poor condition, including six unpaved Category IV roads and two Category III roads with destroyed pavement). Data Source: EA's Progress reports Actual value:

Output: 1.1 Road from Epkin village to Bashkugandy village (Km 89-Km 159) rehabilitated Indicator: 70 km of road rehabilitated and the pavement international roughness index reduced to 3.00 m/km by 2021 (2015 baseline: 8.33 m/km) Achievement: 8.33 Progress/Status: Contract with Todini (civil works contractor) was signed on 7 September 2018 and terminated on 1 December 2020, with only about 9.5% of works completed.
Following rebidding, a new civil works contract (with CR5) was signed on 23 September 2021. Notice of Commencement was issued to CR5 on 14 January 2022.
Data Source: MOTR progress reports, consultants' reports

Output: 3.1 Road sections from Balykchy village to Km 43 and from Kochkor village to Epkin village rehabilitated Indicator: 25 km of road between Epkin and Kochkor rehabilitated and the pavement international roughness index reduced to 3.00 m/km by 2022 (2015 baseline: 8.33 m/km) Achievement: 3 Progress/Status: On 30 May 2022, ADB provided no objection to the extension of the rehabilitation works component completion date from 21 June 2022 to 21 June 2023.
As of 30 November 2023, the civil works contractor has substantially completed construction works, and the road is opened to public.
The target year for achieving the indicator will be revised from 2022 to 2023 once the loan and grant closing date of L3730/G0621-KGZ is extended. The government plans to request ADB's approval for closing date extension closer to the project completion. Data Source: MOTR progress reports

Output: 3.1 Road sections from Balykchy village to Km 43 and from Kochkor village to Epkin village rehabilitated Indicator: 43 km of road between Km 43 and Balykchy village rehabilitated and the pavement international roughness index reduced to 3.00 m/km by 2022 (2015 baseline: 8.33 m/km) Achievement: 3.0 Progress/Status: On 30 May 2022, ADB provided no objection to the extension of the rehabilitation works component completion date from 21 June 2022 to 21 June 2023.
As of 30 November 2023, the civil works contractor has substantially completed construction works, and the road is opened to public.
The target year for achieving the indicator will be revised from 2022 to 2023 once the loan and grant closing date of L3730/G0621-KGZ is extended. The government plans to request ADB's approval for closing date extension closer to the project completion. Data Source: MOTR progress reports

Output: 2. Institutional capacity strengthened Indicator: A RAMS designed and implemented by 2020 (2015 baseline: not applicable) Achievement: Y Progress/Status: RAMS consulting contract (financed under CRP) was signed on 9 August 2018 and was completed on 28 February 2022. So, RAMS Phase 1 was completed with RAMS designed. MOTC established RAMS unit. In 2023, the law on Motor Roads was amended making RAMS application to the annual maintenance planning obligatory.
Recruitment of RAMS Phase 2 consultant (to be financed under CRP-AF) was completed, and MOTC signed the contract with the selected consultant (Roughton International Ltd) on 14 Feb 2023. The duration of the contract is 28 months. During the contract, MOTC's capacity in terms of RAMS implementation will be improved to make RAMS sustainable. Data Source: MOTR progress reports, consultants' reports
Baseline year: 2015 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2015 Baseline value: N Target year: 2020 Target value: Y Actual value: Y

Output: 2. Institutional capacity strengthened Indicator: MOTR staff receive capacity building assistance until 2027 (2015 baseline: not applicable) Achievement: Y Progress/Status: PIU consultants/MOTC staff participate in various capacity building activities (in areas such as project management, procurement, safeguards, RAMS, etc) organized by ADB, international consultants and contractors.
In Q3 2022, PIU consultants/MOTC staff attended PBM trainings on 26-28 Jul 2022. On 25-27 July 2023, over 30 MOTC staff attended FIDIC training. On 27-29 Sep, MOTC's 12 staff attended the 2nd Central Asia Road Conference to share the best international practices in road construction and maintenance, new technologies and materials with counterparts from other countries. Data Source: MOTR progress reports, consultants' reports Baseline year: 2015 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2015 Baseline value: N Target year: 2027 Target value: Y Actual value: Y

Output: 2. Institutional capacity strengthened Indicator: Road safety reforms, audit, and campaigns completed by 2027 (2017 baseline: not applicable) Achievement: N Progress/Status: For the sub-output 1, the contract of the individual international road safety capacity development consultant was signed on 26 May 2022 with completion date of 31 December 2023. MOTC issued the notice-to-proceed on 2 June 2022.
For the sub-outputs 2 and 3 for institutionalizing a road safety audit and defining ICT for monitoring road, traffic, crashes and speed conditions, the recruitment of a consulting firm was completed, and MOTC signed a contract with MC Mobility Consultants GmbH on 13 February 2023. The contract period is 28 months. Data Source: MOTR progress reports, consultants' reports Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Target year: 2027 Target value: Y Actual value: N

Output: 3.1 Road sections from Balykchy village to Km 43 and from Kochkor village to Epkin village rehabilitated Indicator: At least 10% of the employed office staff and project construction workers are women (2018 baseline: not applicable) Achievement: Y Progress/Status: As of 31 December 2024, about 10% of employed office staff and project construction workers are women. Data Source: MOTR progress reports Baseline year: 2018 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2018 Baseline value: N Target year: 2027 Target value: Y Actual value: Y

Output: 3.1 Road sections from Balykchy village to Km 43 and from Kochkor village to Epkin village rehabilitated Indicator: Performance-based road maintenance contract completed by 2027 (2018 baseline: not applicable) Achievement: N Progress/Status: Contracts for civil works with 5 years of performance-based maintenance services were awarded on 14 February 2020. Civil works are ongoing.
On 30 May 2022, ADB provided no objection to the extension of the rehabilitation works component completion date from 21 June 2022 to 21 June 2023. Consequently, the performance-based maintenance component completion date will also be extended from 21 June 2027 to 21 June 2028.
The target year for achieving the indicator will be revised from 2027 to 2028 once the loan and grant closing date of L3730/G0621-KGZ is extended. The government plans to request ADB's approval for closing date extension closer to the project completion. Data Source: MOTR progress reports Baseline year: 2018 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2018 Baseline value: N Target year: 2027 Target value: Y Actual value: N
